_about: Pilot attributes of the extraction evaluation (gold_eval.py): the validated 2025 answers of these attributes are the ground truth. For each one, the search words that should bring up the page the analyst cited; several alternatives are tried and the best rank counts. Edit here to try other words; the next run reports the effect.

GMC_01933.1.name: Climate expertise on the highest governance body

GMC_01936.1.name: Climate policies the company publicly supports

GMC_01930.1.name: Highest governance body responsible for the sustainability strategy
GMC_01930.1.question: Does the company attribute decision-making and oversight responsibility over the sustainability strategy to its highest governance body (the board of directors, the supervisory board, or a committee of the board)?

GMC_01931.1.name: Highest governance body responsible for the climate strategy or transition plan
GMC_01931.1.question: Does the company assign decision-making and oversight responsibility for its climate change mitigation strategy or climate transition plan to its highest governance body (the board of directors, the supervisory board, or a committee of the board)?

GMC_01932.1.name: Functions, teams or committees responsible for implementing sustainability plans
GMC_01932.1.question: Which topics have functions, teams or committees within the company (below or beside the board: a sustainability team, an executive or management committee, a climate working group) that are responsible for implementing them? Sustainability = sustainability plans, strategy or activities in general; Climate mitigation = the climate mitigation strategy or emissions reduction; Transition Plan = the climate transition plan.

_about_narrative: Entries with a question are read by narrative_eval.py: the model answers the question on the company's best pages for the queries, scored against the analysts' validated answers (No Evidence = no).
